traditional: A soft contact. Communication, commerce, and contracts supports limitation, delay, and hard structure - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Mind meets discipline. Serious, deep, careful thinking; apparent slowness that is caution, not lack of intelligence. The trine makes this a natural strength: Rigor, depth, and thoroughness. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Thinking and limit flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what thinking and limit have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and fear and rigidity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: When the details matter, get them out of everyone’s memory and into something you can actually rely on.
readerCopy.body: When the details matter, get them out of everyone’s memory and into something you can actually rely on. When Mercury trines Saturn, thinking becomes more disciplined and communication gets precise enough to support contracts, deadlines, boundaries, plans, and decisions with consequences. Write down the date, responsibility, requirement, or term that nobody can afford to misunderstand later. Clarity now prevents a much more annoying conversation later.
